This is not an occlusion issue as the profile view should show the nasal horn protruding from the top of the beak.

The eye appears somewhat glassy and plastic-like, typical of a statue, but the transition between the eyelid and the scaled skin is slightly soft and lacks the sharp biological definition expected in a high-fidelity generation or photo. It looks like a painted sculpture rather than living tissue.

The visible brow horn seems to merge into the skull with a slightly unnatural smoothness, lacking the distinct rough texture often seen at the base of keratin sheaths on horns, though this may be stylistic.
